select gb.goods_id, gb.common_id,gb.goods_name,gc.plus_goods, gb.goods_image,gb.shop_id,gb.goods_price,gb.goods_market_price,sb.shop_self_support from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base gb left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc on gb.common_id = gc.common_id left join ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb on gb.shop_id = sb.supplier_shop_id where goods_is_shelves =1 and gb.goods_id in
#{goodId}

SELECT common_id,goods_id,common_name,common_image,common_price,common_market_price,common_collect, common_salenum,sb.shop_self_support,gc.plus_goods FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb ON sb.supplier_shop_id = gc.shop_id WHERE common_state = 1 AND (gc.goods_type = 1 or gc.goods_type is null) AND common_verify = 1 AND common_is_screen = 1 AND sb.shop_status = 3 AND (gc.integral_goods != 0 OR gc.integral_goods IS NULL)
AND gc.common_id = #{id}

select gb.goods_id, gb.common_id,goods_name, goods_price, goods_market_price,sb.shop_self_support,gc.plus_goods, goods_image,gb.shop_id,gb.shop_name,goods_salenum,common_is_xian, -- cm.corner_url, gb.goods_max_sale from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base gb left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc on gc.common_id = gb.common_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb ON sb.supplier_shop_id = gc.shop_id where common_state =1 and common_verify = 1 and gb.goods_id in
#{goodId}

SELECT gb.goods_id, gb.common_id, goods_name, goods_price, goods_market_price, sb.shop_self_support, gc.plus_goods, goods_image, gb.shop_id, gb.shop_name, goods_salenum, common_is_xian, gb.goods_max_sale FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base gb LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc ON gc.common_id = gb.common_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb ON sb.supplier_shop_id = gc.shop_id WHERE common_state = 1 AND common_verify = 1 AND gb.goods_id IN
#{goodId}

SELECT gc.common_id AS commonId, gb.goods_id AS goodsId, gc.common_name AS commonName, gc.cat_name as catName, gc.common_stock as commonStock, gc.common_price AS commonPrice, gc.common_market_price AS commonMarketPrice, gc.common_image AS commonImage, gc.common_salenum AS commonSalenum, gc.common_promotion_tips AS commonPromotionTips, gc.common_collect AS commonCollect, gc.shop_id AS shopId, gc.shop_name AS shopName, gc.virtual_goods as virtualGoods, gc.period_of_validity as periodOfValidity, gc.past_due as pastDue,dr.id as putawayId FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base gb ON gc.common_id = gb.common_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.userms}hou_base_dealer_putaway_record dr on gc.common_id = dr.supply_common_id WHERE gc.common_state = 1 AND gc.common_verify = 1 AND gc.common_price != 0 AND gc.shop_status = 3 and gc.goods_type = 2 AND gb.goods_is_shelves = 1
and dr.dealer_shop_id = #{param.shopId}
and gc.common_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.commonName },'%')
and gc.shop_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.shopName },'%')
and gc.cat_id = #{param.catId,jdbcType=INTEGER}
and gc.cat_id in
#{catId}
and gc.common_price between #{param.minPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} and #{param.maxPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL}
GROUP BY gc.common_id
ORDER BY common_add_time desc
ORDER BY common_salenum DESC, common_price ASC, common_add_time DESC
ORDER BY common_evaluate DESC
ORDER BY common_evaluate DESC
ORDER BY common_price desc
ORDER BY common_price ASC
ORDER BY common_salenum desc
ORDER BY common_salenum asc
